title: Eleven Deaths and One Path
subtitle: 危险防范 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 危险防范（灾害防范·危险与逃生）
meta: 主题语境：危险防范（灾害防范·危险与逃生）　|　核心词汇：risk　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 risk 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The path along the cliff has killed eleven people since 1974, and the council's answer, for most of those years, was a sign saying the walk was ① at one's own risk, which nobody reads and which my father called the cheapest thing a council can put up. He walked it twice a week for thirty-one years. He said the real ② risk was never the path but the weather, and that anyone who went out in March was ③ taking a risk he had not counted.

There is a ④ risk of falling, of course, and there is the other one, which no notice mentions: the ⑤ risk that you will find somebody. My father found three, and he said the hardest thing about the path was never the walking. He was sixty-one, he walked alone, and he was by any insurance standard a bad ⑥ risk; he knew it and did not care.

In 1998, after the eleventh death, the council surveyed the path and found that only three sections were ⑦ at risk, and fenced those three, and left the rest open. My father said this was the sentence that proved nobody had walked it: the whole path is at risk, and the whole path is fine.

At the ⑧ risk of sounding like my father, which I am told I increasingly do, I think he was right. The notices that went up in 2003 name eleven ⑨ risks — the loose stone, the tide, the fog — and not one of them is the one that kills anybody, and the number of people on the path has not changed.

He died in 2011, in his own bed, at eighty-one, having walked the path for thirty-one years and fallen on it once. The ⑩ risk he never mentioned, and which I have only understood since, is that the path was the safest thing in his week, and that the risk of losing it was the one he could not name.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 会带来危险的人／事物；隐患
C. 固定搭配：at risk 处于危险之中
D. 固定搭配：take / run a risk 冒险
E. 固定搭配：at the risk of doing sth. 冒着……的风险（做／说）
F. 固定搭配：the risk of (doing) sth. ……的风险
G. 固定搭配：at one's own risk 自担风险；后果自负
H. n. （保险、金融用语）风险对象；承保风险（a bad risk）

items.q: the walk was at one's own risk
the real risk was never the path but the weather
was taking a risk he had not counted
There is a risk of falling
the risk that you will find somebody
only three sections were at risk
At the risk of sounding like my father

answers.why: at one's own risk 意为“自担风险、后果自负”，牌子上写的是这句话，而没人看。
risk 意为“危险、风险”，父亲说真正的风险从来不是路，而是天气。
take a risk 意为“冒险”，三月出门的人是在冒自己没有算计过的险。
the risk of doing 意为“做某事的风险”，指坠落的风险。
the risk that ... 意为“……的风险”，指在路上发现某个人的那种风险。
a bad risk 是保险用语，意为“风险高的承保对象”，父亲按任何标准都是高风险的人。
at risk 意为“处于危险之中”，议会说只有三段处于危险中，就围了那三段。
at the risk of doing 意为“冒着……的风险（做／说）”，用于引出可能不受欢迎的话。
risks 复数意为“隐患、危险的事物”，2003 年的告示列出了十一种隐患。
the risk 意为“风险”，指父亲从未提起过、我后来才明白的那一种风险。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 路上那块牌子写着后果自负。（at one's own risk）
他说真正的风险从来不是路，而是天气。（risk）
三月出门的人是在冒自己没有算计过的险。（take a risk）
当然有坠落的危险。（a risk of）
议会查明只有三段处于危险之中。（at risk）
冒着听起来像我父亲的风险，我认为他是对的。（at the risk of）
answers: The sign said the walk was at one's own risk.
He said the real risk was never the path but the weather.
Anyone who went out in March was taking a risk he had not counted.
There is a risk of falling, of course.
The council found that only three sections were at risk.
At the risk of sounding like my father, I think he was right.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 risk 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: The path along the cliff has killed eleven people since 1974, and the council's answer was a sign saying the walk was at one's own risk.
My father walked it twice a week for thirty-one years and said the real risk was never the path but the weather.
Anyone who went out in March was taking a risk he had not counted, and there is of course a risk of falling.
After the eleventh death the council fenced three sections that were at risk and left the rest open.
At the risk of sounding like my father, I think he was right: the notices name eleven risks, and none of them is the one that kills anybody.
The risk he never mentioned is that the path was the safest thing in his week.
